verdict.rationale: Stripe Radar's rules engine explicitly supports combining risk score thresholds, list matches (value lists, trusted customer lists), and transaction/attribute conditions into allow, block, and review outcomes, with documented rule reference and review queue workflow (docs-1, docs-3, docs-10, docs-14, docs-17, docs-11, docs-18). Community reports confirm real-world rule usage and rule-driven blocking/whitelisting, though allow rules are gated behind support approval for newer accounts (comm-7) and some report false positives needing manual override (comm-3). Missing for 10: a concrete first-party example combining velocity counters + model score + list match in one compound rule, and independent hands-on confirmation of full rule-builder expressiveness beyond docs.
